title: Archives: tar and gzip
summary: Pack a folder into one file, look inside, and unpack it where you want.

text: tar packs many files into one. z compresses it with gzip.

scheme: c   create      x   extract    t   list
z   gzip        f   the archive file follows
text: - Read the letters as a sentence: -czf = create, gzip, file.
- f comes last because the file name follows it.
- List before you extract: an archive can hold hundreds of files, or paths you didn't expect.
- -C unpacks into that folder instead of the current one (make it first: mkdir -p /tmp/x).
